name: entyrix-mcp
description: KYB data from 23 European business registries — search, financials, compliance, network graphs.
long_description: Query 23 European business registries through one MCP server. This bundle is a thin bridge to the remote Entyrix server (https://entyrix.com/mcp/v1), so it always exposes the current tool catalogue: company search, registry-ID lookup, LLM-ready company briefs, full records, financial statements by year, ownership network and relations, paged market filtering, one-call KYB/AML checks, screening of up to 25 companies, public compliance snapshots, public-sector contracts and rankings. Bring your own Entyrix API key from https://entyrix.com.

api_key.title: Entyrix API key
api_key.description: Bearer token from entyrix.com (account → API keys). Without it only discovery and public tools work.
